devices.name: lowgpu-live-low
devices.note: DIAGNOSTIC, not a shipping configuration. Weak-GPU laptop forced to run the LIVE scene: a desktop viewport (>= PHONE_VIEWPORT_WIDTH, so not the video path) plus an explicit ?tier= (isTierForced, so the software-GL poster fallback is bypassed). It exists to measure the WebGL hero's GPU imprint under a software rasteriser — an environment where the product itself serves the poster instead. Excluded from the FPS floors for exactly that reason; its numbers are still recorded and tracked.

devices.name: lowgpu-live-mid
devices.note: DIAGNOSTIC, not a shipping configuration — see lowgpu-live-low. As that profile but pinned to the mid tier, the rung a real 4GB integrated-GPU laptop lands on. Adaptive downgrade disabled so the measurement is of the mid tier itself rather than of the ladder rescuing it.
